# nexus servicelog

Verbs: get

## Usage

```
nexus servicelog [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for servicelog
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus servicelog get`](nexus_servicelog_get.md) | Read a service's recent logs |
